name: Docchi ni Suru no!? ~Onna Kyoushi to Kouhai to ...... Tokidoki Hitozuma~
original_name: どっちにするの!?～女教師と後輩と……ときどき人妻～
source:
While a student, Shigaki tried to ask his teacher out on a date, but she refused because of her position. Disappointed, he accepted the confession of his junior instead.

Then, after graduation, the teacher asked if he was still interested....
